description: The Danish Emergency Management Agency runs a statistics bank of the rescue services, now being phased out as its new system IDUN takes over data output. The page read on 2026-09-28 says the bank holds statistics on call-outs to fires, rescues and environmental accidents and on alarm calls to the rescue services, which users can compose themselves by choosing criteria, at national, regional, municipal or individual fire station level and by day, week, month or year; staff of municipal rescue services can register through the ODIN helpdesk for extended data extracts. Coverage is Denmark. Access to the public statistics is free; no licence is stated. Caveats: data are revised continuously, so figures in publications of different years can differ, and the bank will close once IDUN covers its functions. It supports emergency response and capacity studies, such as relating fire station response loads to building fires and environmental spills by municipality. No related Danish rescue service record is catalogued.
name: Redningsberedskabets Statistikbank: Danish rescue service call-outs to fires, rescues and environmental accidents and alarm statistics (being replaced by IDUN)
